title: B-tree shared cursor overflow-cache invalidation

scope.rationale: invalidateAllOverflowCache clears the valid-overflow-list flag on every cursor attached to a shared B-tree before mutations can stale cached overflow page locations.

external_source_responsibilities: Caller owns the shared B-tree mutex and cursor registry
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete cursor loop is integrated into insert/delete mutation paths, with every shared cursor visited.

contracts.ownership: Cursors and registry are borrowed; only valid_overflow flags are cleared.
contracts.state_and_results: Every cursor in the shared owner becomes overflow-cache-invalid, regardless of its tree handle or current position.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller must hold B-tree synchronization. No callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Infallible, including an empty cursor registry.

representation_differences: Zig stores cursors in an ArrayList rather than the source linked list; traversal and per-cursor flag clearing are equivalent.

oracle.protocol: Mark one or more shared cursors overflow-valid, invoke invalidation, and observe every flag cleared before mutation continuation.
oracle.normalization: Linked-list and array traversal normalize to cursor identity and final flag.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller owns B-tree synchronization.
assurance.malformed_input: Cursor registry is an owned invariant.
assurance.continuation: Idempotent; repeated invalidation preserves false flags.
assurance.performance: Linear in shared cursor count, matching the source.

integration.native_call_path: insert and deleteEntry invalidate all shared cursor overflow caches before mutating cell topology.

independent_review.notes: Requires multi-cursor mutation trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Add pinned-C multi-cursor overflow-cache mutation differential.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/btree.c:550-585 and mutation call sites were reviewed
src/core/internal/btree_core.zig cursor registry, valid_overflow consumers, insert/delete paths, and tests were reviewed
